title: Improve Telemetry live-status trust
summary: Improve the WebView Telemetry tab so missing, stale, unavailable, unsupported, idle, warning, and active encode telemetry states are explicit and easy to scan.
reason: The Telemetry audit found that placeholders, cadence mismatch, neutral KPI styling, flattened GPU/NVENC payloads, and canvas redraw behavior could make telemetry look blank, stale, fixture-like, or broken during operator review.
behavior_before: Telemetry panels could keep placeholder values after optional refresh failures, chart metadata overstated cadence, KPI values were visually neutral, GPU details flattened backend usage status, and canvases were not redrawn immediately after theme changes.
behavior_after: Telemetry panels render explicit unavailable/waiting/stale/clock-skew states, show accurate UI/GPU sample cadence, style KPI and chart panels by semantic state, surface structured GPU/NVENC usage detail, and redraw canvases after theme changes without adding mutation authority.
